summary_en: Policy change: initiation of dividends. FY8/26 year-end dividend amount to be determined at earnings announcement (2026-10-15). Prior policy: no dividends; business growth and strengthened financial base now permit concurrent growth investment and shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice regarding change in dividend policy and revision to FY8/26 dividend forecast (initial dividend)
translation_en_brief: INGS inc. announced on 2026-08-24 a change to its dividend policy and the introduction of an initial dividend for FY8/26 (year ending August 2026). The company had previously maintained a no-dividend policy to prioritize business expansion, talent acquisition and retention, and financial strengthening. Given the advancement of the business foundation, strengthened earnings base, and improved financial condition, the board determined that the company can now sustain growth investment while implementing shareholder returns. The FY8/26 year-end dividend amount has not yet been determined and will be disclosed at the earnings announcement scheduled for 2026-10-15. The second-quarter dividend remains unscheduled. The company states that the dividend policy change reflects a comprehensive assessment of business progress, revenue foundation reinforcement, and financial circumstances, and future distributions will be considered alongside enterprise-value growth, financial strengthening, capital investment plans, and cash-flow trends.
